description: Make the seven controlled selectors in Settings -> Chat -> Model section reflect the user's pick immediately by adding optimistic cache writes to their mutations in website/src/pages/settings/ChatPanel.tsx. Today each of these mutations only has onSuccess -> invalidateQueries(['kirocrewConfig']) and onError -> setSaveError, with NO onMutate, so the SettingsSelect trigger (which reads its value from the mcCfg object served by the ['kirocrewConfig'] query cache) keeps showing the previous value until the PATCH and refetch complete. Convert all seven mutations to the optimistic-update pattern already used by DisplayPanel's tintMut/shellMut and ChatPanel's own tipsMut/dashMut on the same query key: onMutate writes the new value into a structuredClone of the cached config and returns a { prev } snapshot; onError rolls back to prev (in addition to the existing setSaveError copy); onSettled invalidates ['kirocrewConfig'] to reconcile with authoritative server state. This is a single coherent change (same pattern applied across the seven sibling mutations in one file) plus its tests.
steps: In website/src/pages/settings/ChatPanel.tsx, confirm the ['kirocrewConfig'] query type (mcQ) shape used for cache reads: session, session_summary, agent { model, role_models{background,subagent}, role_efforts{background,subagent}, reasoning_effort, soft_stop_budget_secs, completion_keep, completion_keep_chars, fallback_model }, dashboard{...}. Reuse this type (or a local alias) for getQueryData/setQueryData generics so setQueryData writes are type-checked.

Add a small local helper to keep the seven onMutate bodies DRY and correct, e.g. an async function that: awaits qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: ['kirocrewConfig'] }); reads prev = qc.getQueryData<KiroConfig>(['kirocrewConfig']); builds next = structuredClone(prev ?? {}); applies a caller-provided mutator to next; calls qc.setQueryData(['kirocrewConfig'], next); returns { prev }. Model this on DisplayPanel.tsx tintMut/shellMut onMutate. Keeping a helper avoids seven hand-written structuredClone blocks that could drift. If a helper complicates typing, inline the pattern per mutation instead - either is acceptable as long as behavior matches DisplayPanel exactly.

Convert defaultModelMut (patchConfig('agent.model', v)): add onMutate that sets next.agent = { ...(next.agent ?? {}), model: v }; onError keeps existing setSaveError('...failed_to_save_default_model') AND rolls back qc.setQueryData(['kirocrewConfig'], ctx.prev); replace onSuccess invalidate with onSettled -> qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['kirocrewConfig'] }).

Convert defaultEffortMut (patchConfig('agent.reasoning_effort', v)): onMutate sets next.agent.reasoning_effort = v; onError roll back + existing failed_to_save_default_reasoning_effort copy; onSettled invalidate.

Convert backgroundModelMut (patchConfig('agent.role_models.background', v)): onMutate sets next.agent.role_models = { ...(next.agent?.role_models ?? {}), background: v }; onError roll back + existing failed_to_save_role_model copy; onSettled invalidate.

Convert subagentModelMut (patchConfig('agent.role_models.subagent', v)): onMutate sets next.agent.role_models = { ...(next.agent?.role_models ?? {}), subagent: v }; onError roll back + existing failed_to_save_role_model copy; onSettled invalidate.

Convert backgroundEffortMut (patchConfig('agent.role_efforts.background', v)): onMutate sets next.agent.role_efforts = { ...(next.agent?.role_efforts ?? {}), background: v }; onError roll back + existing failed_to_save_role_effort copy; onSettled invalidate.

Convert subagentEffortMut (patchConfig('agent.role_efforts.subagent', v)): onMutate sets next.agent.role_efforts = { ...(next.agent?.role_efforts ?? {}), subagent: v }; onError roll back + existing failed_to_save_role_effort copy; onSettled invalidate.

Convert fallbackMut (patchConfig('agent.fallback_model', v)): onMutate sets next.agent.fallback_model = v; onError roll back AND keep the existing behavior that appends the backend deny reason to failed_to_save_fallback_model (const reason = err instanceof Error && err.message ? `: ${err.message}` : ''); onSettled invalidate. Preserve the reason-suffix logic exactly.

Do NOT modify the other kirocrewConfig mutations in this file that are out of scope for the issue's seven selectors (profileMut, preventSleepMut, summaryMut, budgetMut, keepCharsMut, keepModeMut). Leave their onSuccess/onError as-is. Also leave the SettingsSelect components' JSX (value/options/onChange) unchanged - only the mutation definitions change.

Add a new test file website/src/test/ChatPanel.optimistic.test.tsx following the exact conventions of website/src/test/ChatPanel.defaultModel.test.tsx (vi.mock('@radix-ui/react-select', ...), vi.mock('../api/client', ...) with patchConfigMock and kirocrewConfigMock hoisted, QueryClientProvider wrap helper, openSelect helper). Make patchConfigMock return a controllable/deferred promise so the test can assert trigger state BEFORE the PATCH resolves.

Test - immediate value: with a deferred (never-resolving-yet) patchConfigMock, open the Default Model select, click a different model option, and assert the trigger shows the newly selected model text WITHOUT waiting for patchConfig to resolve or the config query to refetch. Repeat coverage for at least one effort selector (Default Reasoning Effort) and one role selector, plus the fallback model selector, so all four selector categories (default model, default effort, role model/effort, fallback) are exercised.

Test - rollback on error: make patchConfigMock reject once, select a new value, and assert the trigger reverts to the original value after the rejection settles AND the existing error banner copy appears (e.g. /Failed to save default model/). For the fallback selector, assert the banner still includes the appended deny-reason when the error carries a message.

Test - reconcile on success: after a successful PATCH, assert kirocrewConfigMock is re-invoked (invalidate -> refetch) so the value reconciles with server state. Verify onSettled invalidation fires on BOTH success and error paths (the error test should also observe a refetch).

Keep all assertions aligned with the existing radix-select mock behavior (options are real role='option' nodes; trigger is role='combobox' named by label). Reuse label strings already present in ChatPanel ('Default Model', 'Default Reasoning Effort', 'Background Model', 'Fallback Model', etc.).
acceptance_criteria: All seven mutations (defaultModelMut, defaultEffortMut, backgroundModelMut, subagentModelMut, backgroundEffortMut, subagentEffortMut, fallbackMut) in ChatPanel.tsx have an onMutate that cancels the ['kirocrewConfig'] query, snapshots prev, writes the new nested value into a structuredClone of the cached config via qc.setQueryData, and returns { prev }.
Each of the seven mutations rolls back to ctx.prev in onError while still calling its existing setSaveError copy (fallbackMut still appends the backend deny reason).

Each of the seven mutations reconciles via onSettled -> qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['kirocrewConfig'] }) (invalidation runs on both success and failure), replacing the previous onSuccess-only invalidate.

The SettingsSelect JSX and the shared SettingsSelect component contract are unchanged; PATCH paths/payloads are unchanged; no backend files and no in-session switcher files are touched; no new i18n keys are introduced.

website/src/test/ChatPanel.optimistic.test.tsx exists and covers, for the selector categories, (a) immediate optimistic value before the PATCH resolves, (b) rollback plus error banner on failure, and (c) reconcile refetch after settle.
The out-of-scope mutations (profileMut, preventSleepMut, summaryMut, budgetMut, keepCharsMut, keepModeMut) are unchanged.
verification: Intended (run when dependencies are available): cd website && NODE_OPTIONS="" npm run typecheck && NODE_OPTIONS="" npm run lint && NODE_OPTIONS="" npx vitest run src/test/ChatPanel.optimistic.test.tsx src/test/ChatPanel.defaultModel.test.tsx and confirm all pass.

findings: Implemented: all seven Model-section mutations in website/src/pages/settings/ChatPanel.tsx (defaultModelMut, defaultEffortMut, backgroundModelMut, subagentModelMut, backgroundEffortMut, subagentEffortMut, fallbackMut) converted to onMutate(optimistic cache write via shared optimisticConfig helper) + onError(rollback ctx.prev + existing setSaveError copy; fallbackMut keeps the ': <deny reason>' suffix) + onSettled(invalidate ['kirocrewConfig']). Extracted the inline mcQ query type to a named `KiroConfig` alias so getQueryData/setQueryData generics are type-checked; wrapped the shared helper in useCallback([qc]). Out-of-scope mutations (profileMut, preventSleepMut, summaryMut, budgetMut, keepCharsMut, keepModeMut) left as onSuccess-invalidate. SettingsSelect JSX and PATCH paths/payloads unchanged; no new i18n keys. Added website/src/test/ChatPanel.optimistic.test.tsx mirroring ChatPanel.defaultModel.test.tsx conventions (radix-select mock, hoisted patchConfigMock/kirocrewConfigMock/modelsMock, QueryClientProvider wrap, openSelect helper) covering immediate optimistic value via a deferred promise, rollback + error banner (including fallback deny-reason suffix), and reconcile refetch on both success and error, across default model / default effort / background role model / fallback model. VERIFICATION NOT RUN: sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, node_modules is absent and `npm install` returns 403 against registry.npmjs.org (no offline cache), so tsc/eslint/vitest cannot execute here. Verified instead by close pattern comparison against DisplayPanel.tsx tintMut/shellMut and ChatPanel tipsMut/dashMut, and by confirming all asserted English strings exist in website/src/i18n/locales/en.manual.json. Orchestrator/CI must run `cd website && NODE_OPTIONS="" npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npx vitest run src/test/ChatPanel.optimistic.test.tsx src/test/ChatPanel.defaultModel.test.tsx` after push. FOLLOW-UP (commit 3e1f849c9): closed the review-flagged coverage gap by adding dedicated cases in ChatPanel.optimistic.test.tsx for the three selectors that previously had no test and differ from tested ones only by the patchConfig path arg: Subagent Model (agent.role_models.subagent), Background Effort (agent.role_efforts.background), Subagent Effort (agent.role_efforts.subagent). Each has (a) an immediate-optimistic case using the deferred() PATCH that asserts the trigger shows the picked value before the PATCH settles AND asserts patchConfig was called with the exact path string (guards the copy-paste field-name bug class), and (b) a rollback + error-banner case (patchConfigMock rejects once; trigger reverts and /Failed to save/ banner appears). Effort rows seeded with default model 'claude-opus-4.8' and the role model left on 'auto' so bgEffortSupported/subEffortSupported (modelSupportsEffort(role!=='auto'?role:defaultModel)) resolve true and openSelect does not hit the data-disabled path; effort reverts to 'Model default' (the '' sentinel via effortLabels). Reused existing deferred()/wrap()/seed()/openSelect() helpers and the existing radix-select/api mocks; no new mocks and no changes to existing tests.
